first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is also declining; the inherited evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction can improve both completion and early activation. Verifying both records will test whether the prior lifts were durable and whether simplification harmed downstream qualification. A small, guarded experiment is preferable to broad promotional pricing because it targets sustainable activation and avoids margin erosion while preserving lead-quality checks.
